q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of empty hard capsules?
title: Empty hard capsule carbon footprint per kg
short: Add the gelatin or HPMC, colourants and water per kg of capsules using supplier figures, then the dipping, drying and printing energy. Climate-controlled drying rooms usually take much of it, so divide the plant's energy by kg of good capsules.

ul: Drying under controlled temperature and humidity.
Stripping, cutting, joining, printing and inspection.

p: Report per kg, or per lakh capsules by size. HPMC and gelatin carry different supplier figures, so state which.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 106,500 / 30,000 = 3.550 kg CO2 per kg
Add gelatin or HPMC for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
